questions.q: A solution of 200 mL of 1 M KOH is added to 200 mL of 1 M HCl and the mixture is well shaken. This rise in temperature ${T}_{1}$ is noted. The experiment is repeated by using 100 mL of each solution and increase in temperature ${T}_{2}$ is again noted. Which of the following is correct?
options: ${T}_{1}$ is four times as large as ${T}_{2}$
questions.solution:
Heat produced by 200 Meq. of KOH + HCl
$= \dfrac{13.7 \times 200}{1000}kcal$
This is used to raise the temperature of 400 mL. Solution say ${T}_{1}$
Thus, $\dfrac{13.7 \times 200}{1000} = 400 \times S \times {T}_{1}$
Now, heat produced by 100 Meq of KOH + HCl
$= \dfrac{13.7 \times 100}{1000}$
Thus, $- \dfrac{13.7 \times 100}{1000} = 200 \times S \times {T}_{2}$
It is evident that ${T}_{1} = {T}_{2}$ .

questions.q: In an isobaric process, when temperature changes from $T_1$ to $T_2, \Delta S$ is equal to
questions.solution:
The entropy change for a process, when $T$ and $P$ are the variables is given by
$\Delta S=C_P \ln \frac{T_2}{T_1}-R \ln \frac{P_2}{P_1}$
For an isobaric process $P_1=P_2$. Hence the above equation reduces to
$C_P \ln \frac{T_2}{T_1}=\Delta S$
or $\Delta S=2.303 C_P \log \frac{T_2}{T_1}$.

questions.solution:

$P_2=P_1\left(\frac{V_1 \times 2}{V_1}\right)^{1.4}P_2=P_1(2)^{1.4}=(2)^{1.4} P$

questions.q: In isolated system, find the condition for spontaneous reaction.
questions.solution:
For an isolated system, $q=0, w=0\begin{aligned} & \therefore \quad \Delta U=0 \\ & \Delta G=\Delta H-T \Delta S\end{aligned}$
For spontaneous reaction, $\Delta G=-v$ e. $\Delta H=0$ for an isolated system.
Thus, $\Delta S>0$ for the reaction to be spontaneous.

questions.solution:

$∆ ${H}_f^{o}\left({CH}_{4}\right) = -$393 . 5 - 2 $\times$285 . 8 + 890 . 3$

questions.q:
Data given for the following reaction is as follows :

${FeO}_{( s )} + {C}_{( graphite )} ⟶ {Fe}_{( s )} + {CO}_{( g )}$

Substance ${\Delta}_{f}H ° \left({kJmol}^{- 1}\right)$ $\DeltaS ° \left({Jmol}^{- 1}{K}^{- 1}\right)$
${FeO}_{( s )}$ $- 266 . 3$ $57 . 49$
${C}_{( graphite )}$ $0$ $5 . 74$
${Fe}_{( s )}$ $0$ $27 . 28$
${CO}_{( g )}$ $- 110 . 5$ $197 . 6$

The minimum temperature in $K$ at which the reaction becomes spontaneous is_____.(Integer answer)
questions.solution:
${T}_{min} = \left(\dfrac{\Delta ° H}{\Delta ° S}\right)$

${\Delta}^{o}{H}_{rxn} = \left[{\Delta}_{f}^{°}H ( {Fe}_{\left(s\right)} ) + {\Delta}_{f}^{°}H ( {CO}_{\left(g\right)} )\right] - \left[{\Delta}_{f}^{°}H ( {FeO}_{\left(s\right)} ) + {\Delta}_{f}^{°}H ( {C}_{\left(graphite\right)} )\right]$

$= [ 0 - 110 . 5 ] - [ - 266 . 3 + 0 ]$

$= 155 . 8kJ / mol$

$\Delta ° {S}_{rxn} = \left[\Delta ° S ( {Fe}_{\left(s\right)} ) + \Delta ° S ( {CO}_{\left(g\right)} )\right] - \left[\Delta ° S ( {FeO}_{\left(s\right)} ) + \Delta ° S\left({C}_{( graphite )}\right)\right]$

$= [ 27 . 28 + 197 . 6 ] - [ 57 . 49 + 5 . 74 ]$

$= 161 . 65J / mol . K$

${T}_{min} = \dfrac{155 . 8 \times {10}^{3}J / mol}{161 . 65J / mol - K} = 963 . 8K$

$\approx 964K$ (nearest integer)

questions.q: The relation between pressure P and volume V is given by $\text{P}{\text{V}}^{\dfrac{1}{4}}$ = constant. If the percentage decrease in volume is $\dfrac{1}{4}$ , then the approximate percentage increase in pressure is
questions.solution:
$PV^{\dfrac{1}{4}} = Constant$

% decreases in volume $= \dfrac{1}{4}$

$\dfrac{dv}{v} \times 100 = \dfrac{1}{4}$

Now, ${PV}^{\dfrac{1}{4}} = a$

$log ⁡ P + \dfrac{1}{4}log ⁡ v = log ⁡ a$

$\dfrac{dp}{p} + \dfrac{1}{4}\dfrac{dv}{v} = 0$

$100 \times \dfrac{dP}{P} + \dfrac{1}{4}\dfrac{dV}{V} \times 100 = 0$

$\dfrac{dP}{P} \times 100 = - \dfrac{1}{4}\dfrac{dV}{V} \times 100$

$= \dfrac{1}{4} \times \dfrac{1}{4} = \dfrac{1}{16}$
